one_sentence_story: A single sourced filament is tensioned through a transparent Context Capsule, closes into a torus family, survives a cusp-shaped hexagonal fibre test, and ends as an explicitly provisional S6 paper claim with a pointer-only world trace.

beats.causal_move: One source artifact emits one amber filament.
beats.visual_action: A cream source card stands on a dark hexagonal plinth at lower left. A single amber fibre leaves its bottom edge; no second strand or aggregate appears.
beats.claim_boundary: The source pointer is a paper source. The reference image is used only for visual grammar, not as evidence.

beats.causal_move: The filament becomes a readable evidence stream.
beats.visual_action: Three fixed amber pulses travel along the same fibre toward the center. Each pulse leaves a short afterglow, making direction and continuity visible without adding dashboard UI.
beats.claim_boundary: The pulses are an animation device for causal legibility, not measured event data.

beats.causal_move: The evidence stream enters one transparent Context Capsule.
beats.visual_action: The fibre passes through a glass rectangular capsule. A pale-blue outline locks around the amber pulse only after contact; the source card, fibre, and capsule remain visible together.
beats.claim_boundary: The capsule is a visual container for context, not a claim that the paper has measured a physical capsule.

beats.causal_move: The contexted filament closes into a torus family and exposes one cusp hexagonal fibre.
beats.visual_action: The capsule rotates a quarter turn. The fibre folds into three concentric, offset torus loops around it; one loop tightens into a six-sided cusp fibre at the front. Motion pauses for a half-second at the cusp so the transformation can be read.
beats.claim_boundary: Torus and cusp geometry are the candidate's visual grammar. They are not presented as a theorem, measurement, or ImageGen evidence.

beats.causal_move: The closed loop receives a paper-claim label and a non-fabricated world-trace pointer.
beats.visual_action: The torus family holds still. A small receipt plate docks beneath the capsule, linked by the same blue line. The final text is set in two tiers so the hedge is impossible to miss.
on_screen_text: The paper proposes: memory can be a traversable world, not only a log.
beats.claim_boundary: S6 is framed as a paper claim. The world-trace plate shows a pointer slot only; no snapshot contents, consensus, or operational evidence is fabricated.

caption_script.tweet_text: What makes a memory more than a log? Follow one sourced filament: source -> trace -> context -> closed structure. The ending is a paper claim, not consensus: the paper proposes memory can be a traversable world. The world trace is shown as a pointer, not invented proof.
voiceover: The loop closes, but the geometry is only the film's visual grammar.
Paper claim, not consensus: the paper proposes that memory can be a traversable world. The trace pointer is not fabricated evidence.
caption_script.end_card: PAPER CLAIM / S6 -- pointer shown, proof not invented

render.anti_aliasing: fixed renderer defaults; no stochastic noise
render.determinism: fixed camera, fixed coordinates, fixed interpolation, no random seed or particle system

construction: Use Polygon(6) for the dark plinth and Rectangle for the source card; use real Text objects for every label.
Use one ParametricFunction for the fibre with a fixed cubic Bezier path; move three Dot pulse markers with linear interpolation.
Use a transparent Prism or grouped Rectangle faces for the capsule; reveal its cyan outline with Create only after the pulse reaches its center.
Use three Torus objects with fixed major radii and fixed phase offsets; transform the front loop into a six-vertex cusp fibre with a named Transform.
Freeze all geometry at the final frame, then Write the two-tier paper-claim text and receipt plate without adding charts, counters, or pseudo-text.
readability_rules: No label appears before its object is visible.
Keep the paper-claim hedge on screen for the complete final hold.
Use source, context, claim, and pointer text only; no dashboard panels or unreadable pseudo-text.

falsifier.observation_to_test: The film makes a causal chain legible while keeping the S6 statement visibly provisional.
reject_if: A cold viewer cannot order at least four of the five objects as source, trace, capsule, torus/cusp, claim-pointer.
The final frame is paraphrased as a consensus fact rather than as a paper proposal.
The torus family appears before the capsule has visibly received the filament, breaking the one-causal-move-per-beat rule.
The render introduces a second source strand, a decorative dashboard, or any data-like world trace without a verified receipt.
falsifier.refutation_receipt_needed: outsider comprehension notes plus deterministic render receipt; this candidate does not claim either test has already run
